item.text:
**Readiness: ready.** The schema now appends one immutable audit record when an order first reaches `DONE`. Demo purging runs through a `SECURITY DEFINER` function owned by the non-login `demo_purger` role, with a pinned `search_path`. Its trigger checks `current_user`; setting an `app.*` flag does not authorize deletion. Audit truncation has a separate statement-level guard.

Added [purge_demo_account_contract.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-istpDi/workspace/purge_demo_account_contract.sql), which checks restrictive foreign keys onto purge targets against the supported list, along with the purge function’s owner, security mode, and role separation.

Validated on PostgreSQL 18: schema and contract checks passed; repeated completion produced one audit row; the `app` role’s flagged delete and truncate attempts were refused; demo purge succeeded; and an unsupported relation raised `P0001` before deleting the account.
